hero.description: The professional sports analytics platform for coaches, team athletes, and solo athletes. AI-powered insights, real-time tracking, and data-driven performance management.

features.title: Everything you need
features.subtitle: ProTracker combines AI, analytics, and communication
features.aiDesc: Generate personalized improvement plans, weekly nutrition schedules, and injury recovery programs using Claude AI. Get smart task suggestions based on each athlete's weak areas.
features.analyticsDesc: Track athlete assessments across multiple categories with gradient sliders. View trend charts, radar skill profiles, and compare progress over time.
features.injuryDesc: Log injuries with severity levels and assign structured recovery programs. AI generates sport-specific rehab exercises week by week.
features.tasksDesc: Assign targeted training tasks to athletes with priority levels and due dates. AI suggests tasks based on assessment weak areas. Track completion rates.
features.messagingDesc: Built-in coach-to-athlete messaging with real-time updates. Share notes privately or with the athlete. Keep communication organized.
features.nutritionDesc: Generate 7-day AI meal plans tailored to the athlete's sport, position, and dietary restrictions. Athletes can swap foods for nutritionally equivalent alternatives.
features.schedulerDesc: Plan weekly training sessions with a calendar view. Athletes see upcoming sessions on their dashboard. Track session completion.
features.matchesDesc: Log match scores with sport-aware formatting — sets for volleyball/tennis, points for basketball, goals for soccer. Rate individual player performance.
features.multiSportDesc: Built for Basketball, Soccer, Volleyball, Beach Volleyball, and Tennis. Sport-specific positions, stats, scoring, and color themes throughout.
features.wellbeingDesc: Athletes submit daily check-ins rating their energy, sleep, and overall feeling. Coaches see trends and get alerts when athletes report pain during recovery.

roles.coachDesc: Manage your team, track athlete performance, generate AI nutrition and recovery plans.

roles.soloDesc: No coach? No problem. Track your own performance, generate AI meal plans, and improve at your own pace.

findCoach.title: Find your perfect coach
findCoach.subtitle: Browse verified coaches across 5 sports and connect with someone who matches your goals.

how.subtitle: From first login to data-driven training in three steps.
how.step1Desc: Create your team as a coach, join with a code from your coach, or start a solo profile. Sport-specific positions and stats are ready out of the box.
how.step2Desc: Score athletes on gradient sliders, then back scores with objective tests, match stats, and guided evaluations for measurement-based accuracy.
how.step3Desc: Generate improvement plans, weekly nutrition, recovery programs and task suggestions that reference real measured values.

evidence.description: Most platforms stop at coach gut-feel. ProTracker backs every rating with real measurements — sprint times, match statistics, structured evaluations — and tells you how confident each score is.
evidence.point1: 54 sport-specific objective tests with elite & average benchmarks
evidence.point2: Match stats flow into skill scores automatically when you rate a game
evidence.point3: Confidence levels on every metric — see exactly which scores are verified

about.p1: ProTracker is a full-stack sports performance platform designed for coaches and athletes who take performance seriously.
about.p2: Built with modern technology including ASP.NET Core 9, React, PostgreSQL, and the Anthropic Claude AI API, ProTracker gives coaches the tools they need to track, analyze, and improve athlete performance across 5 sports.
about.p3: From AI-generated nutrition plans to injury recovery programs, every feature is designed to save coaches time while giving athletes the personalized attention they need to reach their potential.

testimonials.title: Coaches and athletes love ProTracker
testimonials.subtitle: From full squads to solo grinders — join the players already transforming their game.
testimonials.marcusQuote: ProTracker completely changed how I manage my squad. The assessment tools and AI plans save me hours every week.
testimonials.sarahQuote: The nutrition tracking and injury management features are incredible. My athletes are performing at their peak.

testimonials.aishaQuote: Perfect for recreational players who want to take their game seriously without being on a formal team. I track everything myself — and it just works.
